method: linear measurement of preserved specimens; Materials and methods > Morphological comparisons prints 'A total of 33 measurements were recorded to the nearest 0.1 mm with digital calipers following the protocol of Tang et al. (2012).' and 'All measurements were taken on the left side of the fish specimens.'; no Methods sentence defines eye diameter, so the record is filed as sensory_anatomy
conditions: Holotype GZNU20230216001 of the new species, row 1 of Appendix 3, Table A1 (per-specimen measurements; Methods: 'Morphometric data were collected from 53 well-preserved specimens of the genus Oreonectes (Appendix 3: Table A1).'). Type material as printed: Holotype 'GZNU20230216001, 98.9 mm total length (TL), 81.8 mm standard length (SL), collected by Jing Yu on February 16, 2023,' at Waminggu Scenic Area, Mashan County, Guangxi; Paratypes 'Twenty-four specimens from the same locality as the holotype: GZNU20230216002–216025, 46.2−70.7 mm SL,' and 'Five specimens from Damingshan Mountains, Shanglin County, Guangxi: GZNU2020011505–011509, 59.2−76.7 mm SL,' (1 holotype, 29 paratypes); no sex is printed for any type specimen. Table A1 caption: 'Measurements of the five specimens of Oreonectes damingshanensis sp. nov. and other species. All units in mm. *designates the holotype.' (the caption's 'five specimens' does not match the rows, and no asterisk shows on row 1 in the page reader). Column headers as printed, in order: ID, Species, Voucher number, Total length, Standard length, Body depth, Body width, Head length, Head depth, Head width, three nostril distances, Snout length, Upper jaw length, Lower jaw length, Mouth width, Eye diameter, Interorbital distance, and so on to Outrostral barbel length (36 columns); 'Eye diameter' is column 18 and reads 1.9 in this row; Head length (column 8) is 16.6, so the eye is about 11 percent of head length, inside the 'eyes normal, diameter 6.5–17.1% of head length' of the Diagnosis and 'Eyes present, normal, diameter of 6.5–17.1% HL.' of the Description.
